# 80 in-corpus studies with a primary list; left out: 0 meta-lane, 0 multi-series reanalyses (), 0 other reanalyses (lineage group 3, no new data; each dataset enters through the study that generated it); 80 studies in 79 same_data_as groups; representative chosen per scenario (recurrence_units.tsv)
# list modality: only DE lists represent a study; 0 studies had a non-DE primary list dropped, 0 of them left out for want of a DE list

# list role: only first_look lists represent a study; 0 studies had a primary list with role reanalysis dropped, 0 of them left out for want of a first_look list; 1 studies hold a reanalysis-role list as an alternate only (Santarelli 2019: 32006661__table_s2_mirna_2011)

# multi-bank studies (lineage 'banks'): 7 (Saetre 2007 brain_other+harvard+stanley, no per-bank lists: study tier only, left out of the cohort tier; Maycox 2009 brain_other+harvard, no per-bank lists: study tier only, left out of the cohort tier; Pai 2019 (own list) brain_other+harvard+pitt, no per-bank lists: study tier only, left out of the cohort tier; Mendizabal 2019 brain_other+harvard, no per-bank lists: study tier only, left out of the cohort tier; Ruzicka 2024 mssm+harvard, no per-bank lists: study tier only, left out of the cohort tier; Mendez-Victoriano 2026 stanley+aus, no per-bank lists: study tier only, left out of the cohort tier; Lee 2026 (PsychAD) mssm+cmc, no per-bank lists: study tier only, left out of the cohort tier); their lane does not name or merge a cohort cluster

# model: list k draws gene g with p_gk = |L_k & M_k| / n_k if g in M_k, else 0 (M_k tested gene set, n_k = stated genes tested if <= |M_k|, else |M_k|); every tested gene equally likely; lists restricted to M_k; count of lists containing g is Poisson-binomial; expected = sum over genes of P(X_g >= k)

# exp_expr_*: expression-matched null, same list totals shared out in proportion to the pooled list-membership rate of the gene's expression decile (LIBD BrainSeq DLPFC mean log CPM, else hippocampus, gwas_vs_de/results/libd_mean_logcpm.tsv; genes in neither, removed by LIBD's low-expression filter, join the lowest decile); columns exp_expr_*, genes_q10_expr, p_expr, q_expr_bh, expr_decile, p_cluster_expr, q_cluster_expr_bh

# exp_prior_*: DE-prior null, same list totals shared out in proportion to (count + 1), count = n_de_total of the ours prior; genes not in the prior get the median weight; the DE-prior null is used for aggregate expectations only; its per-gene p and q (p_prior, q_prior_bh, q_cluster_prior_bh) are not evidence for any gene (Paul, 2026-09-29): on Gemma's bipolar disorder and major depression postmortem brain lists (FDR 0.05), the global DE-prior null gives 350 genes at q < 0.1 against 1 under the uniform null, 349 of them low prior (de_prior_lists/checks_2026-09-29/checks_report.md)
# u18_*: the same modelled lists, unrestricted, each a draw of its own size from U = 18000 genes (universe effect alone)
# old_*: every representative list in the scenario, including lists the universe model leaves out, unrestricted, U = 18000

# cohort tier: a group takes the named lanes (pitt, stanley, libd, cmc, mssm, harvard, aus, pritzker, ipsc) of ALL its members; cmc + mssm + pitt + libd one cluster (CommonMind is built from Mount Sinai, Pittsburgh and Penn brains; HBCC donors (cmc lane) recur in LIBD BrainSeq, donor_overlap/); stanley one cluster; groups spanning several named clusters merge them (none merged); a group with no named lane is its own cohort
# cohort chance: P(g in cluster c) = 1 - prod over member lists k of (1 - p_gk); Poisson-binomial over clusters
